doc: Per-hunter run speed and acceleration [game data]: the reference's character attributes (MoveSpeed uu/s, MaxAcceleration uu/s^2), divided by 100 for metres. Ids are our archetypes: bulwark = Oath, dredge = Kingpin, thief = Shiv, mage = Joule, dolm = Tetra, ostra = Void, ashwick = Felix, juggernaut = Brall, archer = Myth, tender = Elluna, gunslinger = Ghost, rimewright = Celeste. climb_tall: the hunter can mantle double-high ledges (bCanWallJump: Myth and Brall only). A hunter not listed uses the default row. body_scale: our hunters stand taller than the source's, so speed and accel are the row times this, which keeps the source's walk in body heights per second (ours, est). The source hunter is 1.76 m (bot nav agent height 176 uu); ours is 2.04 m (the plain medium hunter at Hunter.VIS_SCALE, --move-feel-check 'model ... tall'); 455 uu/s is 2.59 heights/s; 2.04 / 1.76 = 1.16. The farm, the Training Grounds and an expedition all walk through HunterMove.speed and HunterMove.walk (decision 0061, owner 11-11: same speed everywhere, as fast as the source). The glide cruise and the glide steer force (physics glide_cruise, glide_accel) are scaled by it too, so a run into a glide keeps the source's MaxGlide-to-MoveSpeed ratio (1.03-1.12x) and a glide turn takes the source's time.

physics.doc: Ground stop, dash exit, air, fall, glide, dive and mantle tunables shared by every hunter [game data]: the reference hero's movement component and the world settings, uu divided by 100 for metres. brake: BrakingDecelerationWalking (m/s^2), the constant part of the walking stop. ground_friction: GroundFriction (1/s) times braking_friction_factor (UE's BrakingFrictionFactor, default 2) is the share of the speed a let-go sheds per second. braking_substep: UE's BrakingSubStepTime (s, default 1/33): a longer step brakes in sub-steps of at most this. brake_stop_speed: UE's BRAKE_TO_STOP_VELOCITY 10 uu/s (m/s), a brake that leaves less stops dead. min_tick: UE's MIN_TICK_TIME (s), the shortest sub-step braked. Together (UE's ApplyVelocityBraking exactly) a let-go from a run stops in ~0.17 s and 0.31-0.37 m at our 60 Hz step; the source slides 0.28-0.33 m at 30 fps and 0.34-0.39 m at 144 fps (docs/MOVEMENT_PARITY.md). dash_exit_run: a dash ends at this share of run speed (never faster than the dash), so it carries into the walk, brake or jump instead of stopping dead; the data has no hard stop, and the dash curves that set the exact exit are not decoded. Air control is not here: the owner overruled the reference's low AirControl (11-08), see content/rules/tuning.json air. fall_cap: AbyssFallSlowSpeedLimitMin (m/s), the fastest fall, easing to abyss_fall_cap between abyss_slow_from and abyss_slow_to metres under an island's lip over the abyss (AbyssFallSlowDistMin/Max). glide_height: GlideDownwardForceHeightTarget, above which the glider pulls you down at up to glide_pull_vy (GlideDownwardForceMinZVelocity); the pull's extra sink becomes swoop speed on the level-out (tuning.json glide.swoop). glide_cruise: the glide's settled speed, 700 uu/s (m/s: target 800, settles ~700, measured ~720; the old MaxGlide 500 read was the wrong row; item 163 'too fast' was at 6.5 and is an owner question), the cruise for every hunter. glide_accel: GlideTargetXYForce 162,500 over the hunter's Mass 100 (m/s^2), the glider's pull toward where you steer at or under cruise, so a turn or a reversal has inertia (a reversal at cruise ~0.6 s). Both are at body_scale (HunterMove.glide_cruise, HunterMove.glide_accel): 8.12 m/s and 18.85 m/s^2. glide_start_vy / glide_rise_vy / glide_rise_h [game data]: the glider catches a fall the step it opens, at no more than glide_start_vy m/s down whatever the fall, and keeps a rise only up to glide_rise_vy m/s when it opens near the ground, easing to none between glide_rise_h metres up (Loco.glide_start; the canopy then settles to its sink, tuning.json glide.catch). glide_sink [game data]: m/s a glider sinks under glide_height, GlideMinZVelocity -125 uu/s (1.25 m/s; gravity factor 0.025 is -0.37 m/s^2 so the sink cap rules a steady glide; the owner found 2.2 too fast). glide_heat_s: s of a level glide from the open to overheat, the clock every heat cost is a share of (ours: the source coefficients are encrypted; footage ~14 s in Tom Kick's guide, cut to 9 by the owner, 11-02: "lasts too long, not punishing enough"; per hunter x archetype glide_cap). turn_rate: RotationRate yaw (deg/s), how fast the body turns to the cursor: a fixed rate, so a small aim change lands at once and a 180 takes 0.14 s. There is no backpedal or strafe slow: the source has one MoveSpeed per hunter and no aim-relative move scale (UE walking ignores where the body faces), so walking away from or across the aim runs at full speed (--move-feel-check aim_*). mantle_vy_cap / mantle_pull: MantleSuctionUpwardsForceZSpeedCap (m/s) and MantleSuctionUpwardsForceMax over Mass 100 (m/s^2): within Hunter.MANTLE_REACH (MantleSuctionUpwardsForceHeightMax 1.5 m) under a lip the suction pulls you up only while you rise slower than the cap, so a jump's own momentum carries you over [?: the distance curve that scales the pull is not decoded; the max is used throughout]. mantle_launch_keep / mantle_launch_min: MiniMantleXYSpeedTargetCoefficient / Min, the speed onto a ledge you climb (share of run speed, at least this many m/s). dive_vy / dive_accel: GlideDiveZTargetSpeed (m/s) and GlideDiveZForceMax over the hunter's Mass (m/s^2), the glider's plunge while crouch is held under it; dive_steer: GlideDiveXYForceMultiplier, the share of the glide's steering force the keys keep in the plunge; dive_cancel_h: GlideDiveCancelDistance (m) above the ground where the plunge ends and the glide catches you; dive_timeout: GlideDiveTimeout (s) of holding before it ends on its own. step_down: the drop a standing body stays on (down a flight, a ramp or a stone), the source's MaxStepHeight 45 cm; more is a fall, so a walk down stairs never turns into air rules that don't brake (owner 11-11: one movement profile, a fall never becomes forward or back). coyote_s [game data]: s after walking off an edge in which a jump still counts as off the ground, 0.25 s; jump_buffer_s: s a jump press in the air is kept for a landing (ours: the data has no such row; the same in a match and on the farm). land_buffer_h [game data]: falling with the ground closer than this (m), a jump press never opens the glider: it is kept until you land and jumps there (HunterMove.jump_hold), so no press near the ground is lost. glide_floor_rise [game data]: rising, the glider opens no closer to the ground than this (m); held, it opens once you pass it (AirLimits.too_low). jump_trim_in / jump_trim_to / jump_trim_k [game data]: a jump taken faster across the ground than jump_trim_in's first end (m/s, a dash-jump) sheds the excess over ~0.3 s on a critically damped spring (rate jump_trim_k, 1/s^2) down to jump_trim_to, the low end at jump_trim_in's first end and the high end from its second; landing, a dash, a mantle or opening the glider ends it (JumpTrim). Speeds at body_scale. glide_regen_s [game data]: s a grounded hunter takes to refill an empty glider (regen 0.5 of the tank a second). glide_regen_s [game data]: s a grounded hunter takes to refill an empty glider (regen 0.5 of the tank a second). sneak_speed: SneakSpeedMultiplier 0.4, the share of run speed while crouched. speed_cap: MaxMoveSpeed 700 uu/s (m/s), shared by all 12: the ground speed no stack of move-speed bonuses passes. Bonuses add (the source's MoveSpeed is one attribute and its Add modifiers sum, e.g. a kit's +75 with boots), slows and states then multiply that total, and the result clamps to speed_cap (HunterMove.ground_speed). haste: the shared haste status (stims, wards, a Boki's speed call) as a share of run speed [ours: the data has no generic haste].
physics.heat_doc: Glider heat (HunterMove, --glider-heat-check). Tags: [footage] measured from the reference's play, [owner] the owner's pick, [est] ours where the reference's value is locked (its inbound-damage heat coefficients and overheat penalties are named in its data but not decoded). glide_heat_s [owner, Nov 2 'lasts too long']: seconds of level glide before the heat ring turns hot (the footage reads ~14 s; a parity move to it is held for the owner). lift_heat [footage]: heat rate while the glider lifts you out of the abyss, x a level glide (a ~1 s lift from 8 m deep burns a quarter to a third of the bar). lift_tap_heat [est]: the lift's first Hunter.FEATHER_TAP seconds (its quick impulse) heat at this x instead. hit_heat [est]: a hit on a glider heats it this x its damage share, where 34.5 damage is a 30% share (a knock's 250 of 1,050 hp). overheat_burn [?]: share of max health an overheated open glider burns a second, in 20-damage ticks; the source says only "damage over time" (sv/DATA.md 5) and its overheat penalty effects are named, not decoded (sv/briefs/physics.md); no hero-ref clip shows an overheated glider (briefs/hero-ref/*.md: none), so it stays ours (--move-feel-check overheat_burn_s). overheat_speed [owner 11-17]: glide speed share while overheated, a clean 30% slowdown (no extra sink; height and heading are a cool glide's). overheat_lift [owner 11-17]: share of the full abyss lift an overheated glider keeps; 1.0, it lifts like a cool one.

glide_spike.doc: A spiked glider (scripts/match/glide_spike.gd, docs/decisions/0022). Spiked by heat (a player's hit that fills the glider's heat, or any player hit on an overheated one) [wiki Spike] or by a slam (a dunk driving it down at slam_min m/s or more, whatever its heat) [wiki Dunk; data SpikeSlamForceStrengthThreshold, value not decoded, ours est]. land_stun: the stun when a spiked glider lands over ground [wiki 0.7 s]. land_dmg: the additional damage then [wiki: 'additional damage', amount not stated, ours est]. air_stun: s stunned while it falls. fall_vy [?]: m/s, the heat spike's plunge at least (SpikeSlamForceZ, value not decoded, sv/briefs/physics.md; sv/DATA.md 4 says only "stun + plummet"; no hero-ref clip shows a spike, briefs/hero-ref/*.md: none; ours, --move-feel-check spike_fall_vy); a slam keeps its own speed. keep_hv: the share of horizontal speed the spike keeps. reopen_cd: s before the glider can open again. cool_by: the heat a gliding spiker's own glider sheds [wiki: spiking cools you; KINFALL 50 of 100].

jump_pad.doc: The Spring pad (UtilityUse.pad_launch, docs/MOVEMENT_FEEL.md "Launch arcs"). vy [?]: m/s straight up; the source has no launch number (wiki Jump_Pad, sv/DATA.md 9: arm 2 s, 30 s life only) and the one pad use on camera (venator.md Mini Nuke cast 2, f103 of the 10 fps ult cut, 559 s + 10.2 s) is not on disk to measure (/home/claude/svvid gone 11-23); ours, --move-feel-check pad_vy. min_hv [?]: m/s, the least a pad sends you on with (toward your aim if you stood still); ours.
